## Request access

Please send data access and collaboration inquiries to the project lead:

- **Email:** [Fabien.Eloi@lne.fr](mailto:Fabien.Eloi@lne.fr?subject=MeLiDos%20Data%20Access%20Inquiry)

Include the following details in your email:

- Name and institution
- Requested dataset(s)
- Intended research use
- Ethics/compliance status
- Timeline and funding context (if relevant)
